title: NeuroTaint reproduction closeout
verdict: This bounded AgentDojo adaptation is closed with engineering evidence and explicit limits. Independent attribution accuracy and full paper-method equivalence are not established.

paper.title: Ghost in the Agent: Redefining Information Flow Tracking for LLM Agents
paper.reading_scope: Method and evaluation sections 3-5, implementation disclosures, and label semantics in Appendix B.2. Primary-source read for method comparison; no new model experiment. Local evidence is assessed separately.

components.title: Lexical and semantic components
components.local_result: Exact and LCS components, pinned local MiniLM, and fragment scoring are implemented. Ten saved real traces support repeated prefix scoring.
components.limits: Unicode matching, token truncation, three-sentence chunks with one-sentence overlap, and encoded-span coverage are disclosed implementation choices. Component consistency does not establish semantic attribution accuracy.

components.title: Online observation contract
components.local_result: A detached sidecar records each proposal before native tool runtime. Fixed-response controls preserve outbound requests, actions, history and environment, including error paths.
components.limits: This pre-runtime online contract is a local adaptation. Computation is synchronous and has no hard analysis deadline; logs do not reveal hidden model reasoning or internal causal dependencies.

components.title: Real-agent recording consistency
components.local_result: Real Groq execution has proposal-time receipts and exact saved-prefix replay. The latest ten-run calendar batch passes 300/300 consistency checks across 20 executed proposals and 50 argument fields.
components.limits: This establishes the tested recording and replay contract, not source correctness, maliciousness or a causal overhead estimate. Standalone recorder overhead is unavailable.

components.title: Source/sink policy and ordered stages
components.local_result: A fixed workspace policy routes each eligible source and selected leaf argument through the cascade. Ordinary thresholds and the restored-memory semantic threshold are implemented; each skipped or unavailable stage remains explicit.
components.limits: Source eligibility, per-leaf comparison and stopping choices are local. Scenario-specific implicit-string and safe-control threshold profiles are absent. In all three repeated evaluation batches every observed first hit is Tier2; these trials do not exercise later-stage effectiveness.

components.title: DCPG and memory restoration
components.local_result: A private lineage checkpoint and exact native cloud-drive adapter preserve candidate ancestry. A two-session native control restores stored content and lineage; saved traces repeat exactly.
components.limits: Coverage is limited to the tested file adapter and namespace. Real-model cross-session efficacy is unvalidated. The selected live task32 failed at provider validation after search/create; its two executed proposals remain verified. Native query restarts retire active memory bindings and do not prove an environment reset.

components.title: Separate Canary condition
components.local_result: UUID assignment, actual publication/exposure, controlled sink carryover and cross-session restoration are implemented. A fresh task29 comparison has five passive and five Canary injected runs, all completed.
components.limits: This condition changes model-visible source text. No Tier1 sink hit or primary outcome advantage appears in that comparison. The earlier two task31 provider failures are retained. A missing canary does not rule out influence.

components.title: Isolated A/B auditor
components.local_result: Source neutralization and a deferred no-tools A/B judge operate on saved proposal-time prefixes. Seven native controls pass 37/37 checks; two separate Groq auditor requests produce valid predictions without changing primary records.
components.limits: Auditor predictions are not observed counterfactual agent reruns. The local neutralization and conservative trigger are one interpretation. Joint/conjunctive-cause detection is not implemented; independent causal accuracy remains unknown. Zero auditor requests in later batches mean ineligibility, not a negative causal result.

components.title: Independent attribution evaluation
components.local_result: Three distinct ten-slot native batches, saved-prefix ablations, lexical diagnostics and assisted development labels are complete. Native task outcomes and actual payload exposure have valid separate denominators.
components.limits: Independent source-field references, second review/adjudication and independent scoring are pending. Precision, recall and F1 are null. Native utility and attack goals do not label attribution. Original result tables, external benchmark coverage, unseen-tool/attack robustness and defense benefit are not reproduced.

findings.title: User-provided emails receive tool-source LCS candidates
findings.observation: All twenty participant-email fields in the task8 batch occur literally in the user request but not as complete literals in eligible calendar output. Whole-output LCS scores range from 0.8696 to 0.9688 and trigger Tier2.
findings.limit: Character overlap supplies a candidate, not source reliance. This is not an independent false-positive rate or a confirmed flaw in the original authors' implementation. No new experiment is scheduled automatically.

findings.title: Decoded source-region extension
findings.observation: Historical pilot/comparison: 40 selected fields and 560 scored scalar comparisons. Calendar case: 30 selected fields and 330 comparisons. Each export passes the same 12 frozen engineering controls; these are analyses of existing trials, not new executions.
findings.limit: This optional local extension is not an original-paper component or another acceptance gate. No complete selected target literal occurs inside the annotated payload regions; scattered LCS characters do not prove semantic or malicious propagation.

findings.title: Completed assisted review stays development evidence
findings.observation: Twenty Codex-assisted items comprise ten definitive positive references and ten ambiguous items. Exact, LCS and the saved cascade each agree on ten comparable pairs; there are no definitive negative reference pairs.
findings.limit: Authorship remains Codex and independence remains false. These are not independent precision/recall/F1 results. The owner will not be asked to repeat the completed twenty items during closeout.

findings.title: Native task metrics have narrower contracts
findings.observation: Task29 utility checks file modifications, not the quality of suggested activities. Task8 utility checks additions/diff category without explicitly binding the new participants to event24. The attack evaluator checks file13 deletion.
findings.limit: Preserve native values with these limits. None supplies source-content correspondence labels or proves why an action happened.

findings.title: Earlier integration failures remain visible
findings.observation: The lineage task32 and both task31 Canary-pair runs failed at provider tool validation. Valid preceding proposals, exposure records and replay receipts remain retained. The later three completed evaluation batches do not replace these trials.
findings.limit: These provider failures limit tested real-agent paths; they do not establish a NeuroTaint method failure. Their native incomplete outcomes remain unknown.

fallacy_checks.title: Simpson's paradox
fallacy_checks.reason: Keep three protocols and their arms separate; no pooled effect or ASR is reported.

fallacy_checks.title: Ecological inference
fallacy_checks.reason: Repeated slots are repetitions of two tasks, not independent tasks, tools or populations.

fallacy_checks.title: Filtered selection
fallacy_checks.reason: Native read-to-write eligibility and prior development constrain the case set. Generalization is untested.

fallacy_checks.title: Conditioning on common effects
fallacy_checks.reason: No adjusted causal model is fitted. Exposed-only native rates, when shown, retain their descriptive conditioning.

fallacy_checks.title: Base-rate neglect
fallacy_checks.reason: No deployment prevalence, precision or recall is inferred from the balanced/assigned experiment slots.

fallacy_checks.title: Regression to the mean
fallacy_checks.reason: No pre/post adaptation or improvement from outcome-selected extreme cases is claimed.

fallacy_checks.title: Survivorship bias
fallacy_checks.reason: All fixed slots and earlier provider failures remain in their own evidence records; failed native outcomes stay unknown.

fallacy_checks.title: Look-elsewhere effect
fallacy_checks.reason: No significance tests or attack-success-driven replacement search; lexical findings are descriptive.

fallacy_checks.title: Analysis flexibility
fallacy_checks.reason: Prospective plans and fixed scorers are retained. The scalar extension and assisted labels are disclosed development work.

fallacy_checks.title: Similarity versus causation
fallacy_checks.reason: Candidate matches and auditor predictions are not causal reference labels or proof of a defense benefit.

fallacy_checks.title: Temporal order versus reliance
fallacy_checks.reason: Prefix checks establish recorded order; they do not establish model reliance or uniquely identify a contributing source.

limitations: The bounded closeout is complete; independent attribution acceptance remains open at 7/8 gates. Gate counts measure the locally declared checklist, not method equivalence or percentage of research effort.
Verified-in-scope, partial and unvalidated are claim assessments. A component can have an accepted local engineering gate and still be only a partial paper adaptation.
No CTTA, model-weight updates, automatic action blocking or real-account side effects were implemented.

Specialized threshold profiles, joint/conjunctive-cause detection, arbitrary memory backends, original benchmark/model coverage and actual counterfactual agent reruns are outside the implemented scope.
Standalone recorder overhead is unavailable. Pacing, synchronous sidecar, primary-run and whole-worker timers overlap or cover different phases; their sums cannot establish causal overhead.
Operational totals for the three repeated batches exclude earlier integration/control and auditor runs. Token totals are recorded API fields, not complete provider billing.
The current closeout adds zero model requests and schedules no further experiment. Any later independent evaluation or method improvement is a separate research phase.
Runtime HTML/JSONL and local model files are ignored by Git; source, frozen configuration and result notes are tracked. Transfer runtime artifacts separately and exclude credentials.
aggregation_scope: Three distinct study groups; trial outcomes are never pooled across experiments.
